extracted.name: Ashkenazi charoset
extracted.description: Try this simple recipe for ashkenazi charoset, a symbolic food eaten during Jewish Passover celebrations. Chop by hand or use a food processor for a smooth texture
ingredient_lines: 3 apples such as Pink Lady or Royal Gala
50ml - 60ml sweet red wine or grape juice
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Toast the walnuts until dark and fragrant, about 7-10 mins, taking care not to burn them. Allow to cool, then chop finely.

Peel, core and finely chop the apples. Mix with the cinnamon, lemon juice, silan (date syrup), orange zest, sweet wine or grape juice and salt. Add the cooled nuts and stir again to combine. Transfer it to a closed container and keep chilled.
